references.text: God renews the promise of the land to Abram's descendants
God makes a covenant with Abram and promises him the land
God confirms the land promise in the covenant with Abraham
The Lord appears to Abraham at the oaks of Mamre – a parallel to the theophany in 12:7
The promise of the land and descendants is renewed to Isaac
The promise of the land and descendants is renewed to Jacob
The land promise is repeated to Jacob
The Lord shows Moses the promised land and reminds him of the promise to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
Stephen refers to God's promise to give Abraham and his offspring this land
Paul interprets 'your offspring' from the promise to Abraham as a reference to Christ
13:4 confirms and reactivates the memory of the first revelation and altar from 12:7.
12:1 is the call to journey, while 12:7 is the confirmation of the promise upon arrival.
26:24 shows the continuation of the promises to Abraham (12:7) to Isaac.
13:18 shows the continuity in Abraham's practice of building altars as in 12:7.
26:3 confirms that the promise of the land in 12:7 also applies to Isaac.
48:4 confirms that the promise of the land in 12:7 applies to Abraham's descendants generally.
35:7 shows that the meeting with God and the response (altar) from 12:7 is carried forward to Jacob.
Gen 1:8 confirms that the land the Israelites are to take possession of is the promise from 12:7.
2 Cor 1:20 shows that the promise in 12:7 is fulfilled in Christ.
Luke 1:73 confirms that the promise in 12:7 is fulfilled in Jesus.
Exod 6:8 confirms that the land the Israelites are to receive is the promise from 12:7.
